title: Finans Portali budget vs actual comparison showing wrong actuals - previous year data mixed in
description: The budget vs actual comparison dashboard is showing incorrect actual spend figures. Some line items show actuals that are clearly from last year - amounts that match last year's transactions exactly. The issue is only on the comparison dashboard, not on the individual transaction reports.

worklogs.description: Checked the budget vs actual dashboard query. The fiscal year filter has a bug: when the fiscal year starts in January, the year filter should use calendar year 2025. The query has an off-by-one error and pulls January 2024 data for the 'January 2025' slot.
The dashboard was built with the assumption that fiscal year starts in April. The company actually uses a January fiscal year. The fiscal year start parameter was not updated during setup.
Updated the fiscal year start configuration to January 1. Dashboard recalculated with correct actuals.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I investigated the budget vs actual comparison data. I traced which transactions are being included in the actuals. For January and February 2025, the dashboard is pulling data from January and February 2024 instead. This is a fiscal year configuration issue: the Finans Portali fiscal year is configured to start in April (common for Turkish government-aligned organizations), but your company uses a January fiscal year. comments.author: customer
comments.message: Our fiscal year starts January 1st each year. How do we fix this?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I need to update the fiscal year start setting in Finans Portali from April to January. This will recalculate all year-to-date figures on the dashboard. It will also affect any saved period comparisons you have set up. Are there any custom period reports (quarterly splits, half-year comparisons) that use the fiscal year period definitions? Those will need to be verified after the change.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: We do not have any custom period reports set up yet - we are still in the first few months of using the system. Please proceed with the fiscal year change.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Fiscal year start updated to January 1. The dashboard is now recalculating. Please reload the budget vs actual comparison dashboard and verify the actuals look correct.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Dashboard reloaded. The actuals are now showing 2025 data correctly. The January 2025 figure matches what we see in the transaction reports. Very good, thank you.

resolutionNote: Finans Portali fiscal year start was configured for April (a common default). Company uses January fiscal year. The mismatch caused the budget vs actual dashboard to pull prior-year data for the first 3 months of the calendar year. Updated fiscal year start to January 1.

csat.comment: Dashboard now showing accurate data. Should have been caught during initial setup.
